updates.name: Peter T. Doran
updates.bio: Professor holding the John Franks Endowed Chair in Louisiana State University's Department of Geology and Geophysics, working on hydrogeology, polar environments, and astrobiology with planetary protection. Trained in hydrology and hydrogeology (PhD, University of Nevada, Reno), and a Fellow of the Geological Society of America.

updates.name: W. Berry Lyons
updates.bio: Emeritus faculty member in Ohio State University's School of Earth Sciences who formerly directed that school and OSU's Byrd Polar and Climate Research Center. He has led the McMurdo Dry Valleys LTER; his group studies how Antarctic ecosystem biogeochemistry responds to climate change, weathering and carbon cycling in small mountain watersheds, and land-use effects on water quality.
updates.research_interests: biogeochemistry of Antarctic land and aquatic ecosystems under climate change; chemical weathering, erosion, sediment transport and carbon cycling in small mountain watersheds; water-quality effects of urban, suburban and agricultural land use

updates.name: Mike Crowley
updates.bio: Technical director at Rutgers' Center for Ocean Observing Leadership (RUCOOL), managing lab operations, data delivery and the team's external communications. Also described as overseeing MARACOOS data collection across the Mid-Atlantic Bight from satellites, HF radar and gliders, observations used to drive and test ocean forecast models. Holds Rutgers geography degrees (BA 1991, MS 1993).
updates.research_interests: ocean observing with satellites, HF radar and underwater gliders; data for testing and improving Mid-Atlantic ocean and atmospheric forecast models

updates.name: Jenny Gray
updates.bio: Monterey Bay Aquarium chief executive since May 2026, after 17 years heading Zoos Victoria in Australia. She served a two-year term leading the World Association of Zoos and Aquariums as president, holds a University of Melbourne doctorate in ethics, and is known for work on animal ethics, welfare and conservation.

updates.name: Julie Packard
updates.bio: Helped found the Monterey Bay Aquarium and served as its executive director for over 40 years, growing it into a conservation organization with Seafood Watch, policy work and field research on sea otters, white sharks and tunas. She became vice chair of the Aquarium's board of trustees in 2026, chairs the MBARI board and is a Packard Foundation trustee.

updates.name: Antje Boetius
updates.bio: President and CEO of MBARI, previously director of Germany's Alfred Wegener Institute for Polar and Marine Research (2017-2025). She is a geomicrobiology professor at MARUM, University of Bremen, and leads a group at Bremen's Max Planck Institute for Marine Microbiology. Her research examines climate-change effects on marine microbes and on polar and deep-sea ecosystems.
updates.research_interests: biological oceanography; microbial ecology; deep-sea biology; ocean biogeochemistry; climate effects on polar and deep-sea ecosystems; seafloor observatories and robotic sampling
